claim: Public frontend and private data are separate layers with one direction of flow: the public repo holds code, invented fixtures and neutral examples; every real organization value stays in the organization's own store and reaches the app only at runtime. A private value may not cross as an example, placeholder, default, constant, loop bound, comment, test or setup helper.
